integrity_notes: The statements have a self-contained proof using a standard bounded-martingale FCLT; a deterministic exhaustive checker and seeded Monte Carlo tests are provided, neither constituting independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed independent parent choices with \(0<p<1\) only; neither boundary probabilities nor \(p\) varying with \(n\) are treated.
The Brownian limit is annealed for tree randomness; no quenched random-walk-on-tree statement is asserted.
A broader unlocated abstract metric invariance principle could affect historical priority.
title: A uniform Brownian distance-field limit for Bernoulli recursive trees
